commands: python3 scripts/me_supervisor.py start --data-dir DIR --workspace DIR [--profile production|configure|test] [--mode dev|provision] [--require-service] [--opencode-bin PATH] [--model M] [--no-auto] [--max-attempts N] [--max-stagnant N] [--attempt-timeout S] [--wall-timeout S] [--upstream-contract PATH] [--upstream-doctor PATH] [--intelligence-url URL] [--require-backup] [--allow-install] [--no-install]
python3 scripts/me_supervisor.py resume --data-dir DIR [--require-service] [--max-attempts N] [--max-stagnant N] [--attempt-timeout S] [--wall-timeout S]

python3 scripts/me_supervisor.py recheck --data-dir DIR [--profile production|configure|test] [--require-service] [--opencode-bin PATH] [--upstream-doctor PATH] [--upstream-contract PATH] [--require-backup]

exit_codes.0: READY (production) | CONFIGURED (configure, explicitly not complete) | TEST_READY (test, synthetic only)
exit_codes.4: NEEDS_INPUT (genuine operator gate, structured redacted reason)

opencode_turn.auth_gate: CLI-level auth errors (stderr + JSON error parts only, never prose) park NEEDS_INPUT opencode-cli-auth-required (secure `opencode auth login` + resume, session kept, no STALLED burn); developer auth files never read; default model preserved
opencode_turn.env_scoped_permission: OPENCODE_PERMISSION=<json external_directory allow ONLY <workspace>/** + <data-dir>/**; operator entries merged last so operator deny wins; never touches global ~/.config/opencode>; no XDG overrides; operator env inherited
opencode_turn.shared_active_deadline: drive shares remaining ACTIVE budget via opts._deadline_mono; doctor/probes clamp timeouts (min 1s)

doctor.anchor_file: <data-dir>/supervisor/doctor.sha256 (0600 JSON {digest, files, contract}; checked every invocation/resume + post-run)
doctor.cwd_contract: cli.mjs => repo root (parent.parent); standalone bin => its parent dir; tests invoke from arbitrary install cwds

env_extra.ME_UPSTREAM_MODE: full (set from config upstream.mode when operator has not set it explicitly)

doctor.integrity_closure: operator-pinned ME_UPSTREAM_DOCTOR_SHA256 (closure digest) enforced when set; else ME_UPSTREAM_DOCTOR_MANIFEST release-manifest exact match; else NO silent TOFU (NEEDS_INPUT UNVERIFIED_DOCTOR_SOURCE); tampered entrypoint OR imported module fails; post-run re-verify closes swap-during-run race; legacy entrypoint-only anchors rejected; symlinks refused; approved patches folded via ME_UPSTREAM_APPROVED_PATCHES
doctor.invocation: live subprocess only; streaming caps (64KiB doctor cap, flood kill), process-group TERM->KILL->reap, residual pipe-holder kill via spawn-time pgid, bounded joins, SIGINT/SIGTERM persist RUNNING, shared ACTIVE deadline clamp
doctor.required_contract: upstream-platform-v1/full.1 (top-level or checks.doctor_contract; C requires, A to implement in results/setup-doctor-contract.json; fail-closed until present)
doctor.source: A-owned infra-server src/upstream-doctor.mjs via src/cli.mjs upstream-doctor (probing ENABLED), cwd = doctor module root (vendor manifest resolved there, never caller data dir)

strict_ready_rules.intelligence: keyPresent true, selfHosted true (no managed default)
strict_ready_rules.mode: full only (core computer-plane dev/partial never production READY)
strict_ready_rules.probe: true; probed:false anywhere or unknown sentinels refuse READY
strict_ready_rules.supervisor: health.status ok, health.docker true, authenticated list (no 401)

verdict_mapping.NEEDS_INPUT: supervisor NEEDS_INPUT (unverified doctor source / missing doctor / operator license/model/hardware gate; independent fixable work continues)
verdict_mapping.READY: supervisor PASS only after contract marker + all required evidence verified

install.allow_install_semantics: --allow-install acts ONLY when binary missing; existing DEV CLI never modified/downgraded; user-invoked start defaults allow_install=True unless --no-install
install.method: official primary installer ONLY when binary missing; never modifies existing CLI
install.pinning: OPENCODE_VERSION / OPENCODE_PIN_VERSION passed as install script --version X.Y.Z (v1 track only); digest recorded always, enforced when OPENCODE_INSTALLER_SHA256 is pinned (64 hex)
install.redirects: https hosts only (opencode.ai, www.opencode.ai, raw.githubusercontent.com), max 3, 60s whole timeout, 1MiB script cap, status 200, sanity contains opencode
install.test_seam: _INSTALL_RUNNER / dry_run short-circuit before any network; no DEV download/downgrade in unit tests

permissions_scoping.classification: taskpath (inside workspace/data-dir, covered by scoped allow; denial = scoping bug) vs external (outside install-owned trees; agent left scope, not an operator credential gate)
permissions_scoping.events: bounded structured permission-needed signals (permission-requested, permission-denied, question-asked; max 20 parsed, 8 recorded) appended to attempt stderr tail
permissions_scoping.scoped_env: OPENCODE_PERMISSION external_directory allow for <workspace>/** + <data-dir>/** only (operator denies win)

profiles.configure: CONFIGURED terminal (explicitly not complete, never claims READY)
profiles.production: default; FULL bar (live home health/runtime + full upstream doctor READY with versioned contract + source/license/DB/model/user identity); fixture/flags/no-probe/arbitrary-200/fake-license/unknown never READY; operational READY excludes backup claims (backup.supported=false); configuration-only is distinct CONFIGURED, not READY
profiles.test: named TEST profile only; fixture providers complete here as TEST_READY (synthetic, never production READY)

state.lock: <data-dir>/supervisor/lock (fcntl exclusive, concurrent runs refuse; holder pid/lstart message-only)
state.state_file: <data-dir>/supervisor/run.json (0600, atomic, versioned schema_version=1, strict bounds, redacted events)

storage_backup_bar.commands: backup full / restore full refuse incomplete archives explicitly (exit 1); legacy SQLite-only behavior preserved
storage_backup_bar.default: backup_coverage OPTIONAL stating backup.supported=false (SQLite-only sqlite+tasks+household; operational READY excludes backup claims)
storage_backup_bar.manifest: full archives record coverage=[sqlite, tasks, household] + uncovered_volumes=[] + explicit coverage_note (never claims Postgres/Intelligence)
storage_backup_bar.policy: operational agent readiness does NOT claim backup-complete; complete upstream backup is an explicit SEPARATE unsupported capability (backup.supported=false) until a real verifiable path lands
storage_backup_bar.require_backup: explicit --require-backup (or ME_REQUIRE_BACKUP=1) product policy: truthfully UNSUPPORTED/NOT READY (FAIL with concrete pg_dump/volume-copy + Intelligence-deployment integration path), never a checkbox PASS; omission of cfg.volumes hides nothing
storage_backup_bar.required_ids: backup_coverage joins production required set ONLY under --require-backup/ME_REQUIRE_BACKUP=1

upstream_mode.absent: pre-migration configs without upstream section are preserved (no silent default); upstream parks NEEDS_INPUT until operator selects explicitly
upstream_mode.config_key: upstream.mode = full | core (default full on fresh installs)
upstream_mode.core: upstream computer-plane dev/partial profile (per-user computers via supervisor), NOT the original Me task-broker runtime; never production READY (upstream parks NEEDS_INPUT)
upstream_mode.full: FULL OpenBot platform + licensed self-hosted Intelligence primary; native harness serves product traffic (BOT_PROVIDER/BOT_MODEL/OPENAI_BASE_URL in service.env + home process env)
upstream_mode.reruns: explicit choice is sticky (flag wins when given); fresh installs default full
upstream_mode.service_env_activation: config/service.env activates ME_UPSTREAM_MODE + native BOT_* mapping (non-secret routing only); config.json alone is not provisioning; build_home_env emits the same into the home process
